newsitem.title: USA: Cassini, Stonehill acquire 80 pct of He-Ro.
newsitem.headline: Cassini, Stonehill acquire 80 pct of He-Ro.

text.p: He-Ro Group Ltd said on Wednesday that Oleg Cassini, Oleg Cassini Inc and Stonehill Investment Corp will invest $7 million in He-Ro and will receive 80 percent of He-Ro's common stock.
He-Ro will be renamed Oleg Cassini Group International Ltd, with Cassini as its new chairman.
He-Ro, which markets a line of ladies' evening and special-occasion wear, said it will use the proceeds to reduce and restructure debt and for other purposes.
The deal is subject to approval by regulators and certain third parties.
He-Ro shares closed at 1-1/2, up 3/8 for the day.
